versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart E — Power-Plant Installations; Reciprocating Engines
versions.text: Fach liquid cooled engine shall be provided with an independent cooling system. The cooling system shall be so arranged vhat no air or vapor can be trapped in any portion of the system, except the expansion tank, either during filling or during operation.
